policy_notes.note: HUD 2026 Budget Management Letter: vouchers are funding-constrained. PHAs asked to stop issuing new vouchers (except HUD-VASH and FYI), pause new project-based voucher commitments, and cut payment standards, ending exception payment standards and staying inside the 90-110% basic range. Expect payment standards toward the low end of the range.
NSPIRE inspections for vouchers delayed to 2027-02-01 (third extension). Until then PHAs may still inspect under the old HQS (24 CFR 982.401). The checklist here aims at both.

Emergency Housing Vouchers are ending: families under EHV HAP contracts on 2026-09-30 move to Tenant Protection Vouchers by 2026-12-31 (PIH 2026-25); closeout from early 2027. For a landlord the lease continues as an ordinary voucher.
PHAs may use HCV admin fees for landlord signing/retention bonuses, security and utility deposits and holding fees (PIH 2022-18). Optional and per PHA; 2026 budget pressure makes them scarcer.

reasons: City permit/licence required: Yes: register before operating; registration valid 3 years; renew 60-180 days before expiry; liability insurance required.

Caps/density: Per-building cap: buildings with 4 or fewer units unlimited; 5+ units allow 4 STRs plus 1 per 4 units over 4 (pre-2019 STRs grandfathered). Units receiving affordable-housing subsidies cannot be STRs.

permit.value: Yes: register before operating; registration valid 3 years; renew 60-180 days before expiry; liability insurance required.

primary_residence.value: No. Operator must certify being the legal owner or tenant with authority to rent; a responsible person must live or work within 50 miles.

zones.value: Ch. 856 has no zone list; operator certifies zoning compliance. Rooming houses, hotels and congregate housing are regulated elsewhere.

caps.value: Per-building cap: buildings with 4 or fewer units unlimited; 5+ units allow 4 STRs plus 1 per 4 units over 4 (pre-2019 STRs grandfathered). Units receiving affordable-housing subsidies cannot be STRs.

max_occupancy.value: No STR-specific cap; building, housing and fire-code occupancy limits apply, and exceeding them counts toward nuisance revocation.

taxes.value: 7% STR excise tax on gross revenue (Ch. 315); Airbnb collects under a voluntary agreement since Oct 2019; operators on other platforms file themselves.

listing_id.value: Yes: registration number in every listing; registration and city advisory displayed inside the entrance.

pending.value: No pending STR rule change shown; the city STR page describes the existing registration (3-year permit, registration ID in listings) and 7% excise tax.

state_preemption.value: No statewide STR preemption enacted. HB 563 (134th GA, 2022) was reported from committee but never passed; later bills not checked.
